title: The Holocaust in Literature (in English)
description: Discusses literary responses to the Holocaust with a focus on contemporary (autobiographical) fiction. Focuses on ethics and aesthetics of representation, subjectivity as witnessing, trauma and memory, intersectionality and identity, narrative representations of marginalized experiences and the challenges of translation.
notes: Credit will be granted to only one of ENSH 486, ENSH 586, GMST 586.
Offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
